title: SSRF allowlist is additive-positive (not blocklist) — correct and must stay
description: is_valid_fetch_host in peer_fetch.rs requires IPv4 to be in 100.64.0.0/10 (Tailscale CGNAT) and IPv6 in fc00::/7 (ULA). Any IP outside those ranges is rejected, including all public-internet addresses. A blocklist approach (reject RFC-1918, loopback, link-local; pass everything else) is the classic SSRF mistake that leaves public-IPv4 open. A future contributor should not 'simplify' this to a blocklist.
